title: Banana Sunflower Cinnamon Bites
steps: Slice the bananas into thick rounds — use however many are ripe; four is a guide, not a requirement.
Sandwich pairs of rounds with a spoonful of sunflower seed butter.
Dust with the cinnamon, then press the chia and pumpkin seeds onto the edges.
Freeze on a lined tray for 1 hour, then move to a container.
storageNotes: Eat within a day if kept in the refrigerator, since cut banana browns quickly. Frozen they keep 2 weeks and are better that way — take them out 5 minutes before eating.
goldenRuleCallouts: Sunflower seed butter carries this, so the week stays free of tree nuts entirely.
Uses the ripe bananas already in the house before they turn — freezing is what buys the extra days.
